::: {#def-slr-deviation}
#### Deviation from the conditional mean

In a conditional Gaussian model (@def-cond-gaussian),
the **deviation** $\cdev_\iobs$ of outcome $\Outvar_\iobs$
is its [deviation from its population mean](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-deviation-pop-mean),
taking the mean conditional on $\Predvar_\iobs = \predvar_\iobs$:

$$\cdev_\iobs \eqdef \Outvar_\iobs - \mean(\predvar_\iobs).$$
:::
